name: WoW Forever
description: Native PS5 homebrew port for running the World of Warcraft: Forever Windows client directly on a jailbroken PS5 through Wine, vkd3d-proton and Vulkan. Supports login, character selection, gameplay, sound, the game's native controller UI, DualSense touchpad mouse control, USB keyboard and mouse, PS5 on-screen keyboard input and uncapped rendering. Requires your own World of Warcraft installation and account; no game data is included.
author: BeLikeBrett
